crossRefs.note: He went out to the spring of the waters, and threw salt into it, and said, “Yahweh says, ‘I have healed these waters.…
Elisha sent a messenger to him, saying, “Go and wash in the Jordan seven times, and your flesh shall come again to you…
The man of God asked, “Where did it fall?” He showed him the place. He cut down a stick, threw it in there, and made…
Then he cried to Yahweh. Yahweh showed him a tree, and he threw it into the waters, and the waters were made sweet.…
When he had said this, he spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, anointed the blind man’s eyes with the mud,
because the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.
However he shook off the creature into the fire, and wasn’t harmed.

translations.web: But he said, “Then bring meal.” He threw it into the pot; and he said, “Serve it to the people, that they may eat.” And there was nothing harmful in the pot.
translations.bsb: Then Elisha said, “Get some flour.” He threw it into the pot and said, “Pour it out for the people to eat.” And there was nothing harmful in the pot.
translations.kjv: But he said, Then bring meal. And he cast it into the pot; and he said, Pour out for the people, that they may eat. And there was no harm in the pot.
translations.asv: But he said, Then bring meal. And he cast it into the pot; and he said, Pour out for the people, that they may eat. And there was no harm in the pot.
